name: SurGE (Survey Generation Evaluation)
description: SurGE is a benchmark and evaluation framework for scientific survey generation in computer science, featuring test instances with topic descriptions, expert-written surveys, cited references, and a large academic corpus, along with an automated evaluation framework measuring comprehensiveness, citation accuracy, structure, and content quality.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the paper itself, so it is not yet widely adopted but is positioned as a specialized evaluation for scientific survey generation.
notes: Addresses the lack of standardized benchmarks for scientific survey generation and includes a large-scale academic corpus.
